english:
Stunning a <link Champion [#CombatantClassifications] /> with an Elemental Weapon triggers an explosion matching the Weapon's element that deals up to <pve 315 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a 5 meter radius, scaling down to 0% damage at the edge, and applies a matching debuff:
• <arc Arc />: <arc Jolt />
• <solar Solar />: <solar Ignition />
• <void Void />: <void Volatile />
• <stasis Stasis />: <stasis Freeze />
• <strand Strand />: <strand Sever />

Has no effect on Kinetic Weapons.

source.text:
Upon stunning a Champion with an Elemental Weapon:

Triggers an Elemental-Matching Explosion that deals up to 315 Elemental Damage and inflicts an Elemental Debuff over 5 meters, down to 0% damage.

Arc: Jolt | Solar: Ignition | Void: Volatile
Stasis: Freeze | Strand: Sever

Has no effect on Kinetic Weapons.
